releases.name: AniList
releases.notes: Sync anime and manga lists, including chapter progress, ratings, dates and rereads. Manga pairs with catalogs declaring anilistmangaid. Existing anime links and episode coverage are preserved.
releases.description: Syncs your anime and manga lists, progress and ratings with AniList.

releases.name: Subtitles
releases.notes: Fixes OpenSubtitles search, which returned no results. Searches by title when a title has no IMDb or TMDb id, and accepts three-letter language codes such as eng.
releases.description: Searches OpenSubtitles and Wyzie for subtitles and fetches the chosen file.

releases.name: Stremio add-ons
releases.notes: Allows HTTP add-ons on localhost, 127.0.0.1 and ::1 with private-network consent. Remote add-ons require HTTPS.
releases.description: Browses Stremio add-on catalogs and plays their streams and subtitles.
